title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack (Java & Kafka) (Cloud Operations Resilience Engineering)
description_html: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack (Java & Kafka) (Cloud Operations Resilience Engineering)       Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who solve real problems and meet real customer needs.        We are seeking a   Full Stack Software Engineer   to join our Messaging Platforms team. You will be responsible for the design, deployment, and operational health of our enterprise solution, which serves as a mission-critical platform for handling all event-management at Capital One.        The   Cloud Operations Resilience Engineering (CORE)   Technology division is responsible for enabling and evolving Capital One’s foundational cloud infrastructure layer, including observability, connectivity, resilience and availability.        What You’ll Do:         Develop end user API:   Lead the design, development, and maintenance of our developer APIs for kafka developer tooling, work with Java and Spring framework refactoring code for compliance and adding features as required        Automation & Scalability:   Engineer robust solutions and automated CI/CD pipelines to streamline code deployments        Operational Excellence:   Drive system reliability by leading incident management, defining technical requirements, and monitoring key performance metrics to ensure platform health.        High-Volume Support:   Provide dedicated support for our shared Kafka Platform and its related API services, proactive troubleshooting, and rapid production issue resolution.        Security & Cloud Infrastructure:   Code with spring-security and deploy cloud-native deployments on Openshift, implementing enterprise-grade security standards (mTLS, JWT, and KMS)        Core Technical Leadership:   Utilize your expertise in Java, Kafka, Kubernetes, and observability tools like Datadog to build, secure, and optimize our platform          Basic Qualifications:         Bachelor’s Degree        At least 3+ years of experience in software engineering (Internship experience does not apply)          Preferred Qualifications:        5+ years of experience in Java programming language        5+ years of experience working with open-source frameworks, specifically the Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring MVC)        3+ years of experience with enterprise messaging and event-streaming platforms, including Apache Kafka and IBM WebSphere MQ        3+ years of experience implementing and managing CI/CD tools and deployment pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)        2+ years of experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, or another cloud service        2+ years of experience in Agile practices (Scrum or Kanban)        Experience leveraging interactive AI tooling to accelerate productivity, utilizing capabilities beyond basic code completion            At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (i.e. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, E-2, E-3, L-1 and O-1, or any EADs or other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer). Job Category  Software Engineering    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.         About The Team:     The DB Schema team's mission is to provide the tooling and expertise necessary to evolve the Salesforce database schema in a consistent, secure, and automated manner, thereby eliminating downtime and scaling the growth of Salesforce's core service. We are a team of highly collaborative, innovative, and motivated software engineers who support and enhance a service that is mission-critical to Salesforce's core business. Our diverse team upholds Salesforce's values of equality, giving back, customer trust, and innovation.     The Role:     Seeking a Senior Software Engineer for a high-impact team that enables thousands of developers in every stage of the software development lifecycle, builds tooling that delivers schema releases at an enterprise scale, and serves as the foundation of our industry-leading multi-tenant architecture. The team focuses on developing schema management solutions that meet the scalability, availability, performance, and security requirements of Salesforce's core service offering. This role requires collaboration across several teams and stakeholders to support Salesforce-wide initiatives, including our transition to Salesforce DB and to the public cloud. Strong service ownership is highly valued — balancing short-term operational solutions with long-term technical solutions through both pragmatic and innovative approaches.     Responsibilities:       Drive and deliver enhancements to schema lifecycle tooling that serves multiple database engines across Salesforce's pre-prod and prod fleet    Own major subsystems end-to-end: from technical design through implementation, testing, and production rollout    Make design decisions on the basis of performance, scalability, and future expansion    Provide operational support for schema releases, including incident response and root cause analysis    Collaborate with release management, database infrastructure, and application teams to define and deliver safe deployment strategies    Use AI tools as a force multiplier for development, testing, and operational workflows    Guide and support junior engineers through mentorship and technical feedback      Required Skills:       5+ years of experience building Java applications; proficiency in Python    Experience with SQL, designing and building platform services, or infrastructure automation at scale    Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous problems and drive them to concrete, opinionated technical designs    Track record of owning production services — incident response, operational maturity, monitoring      Optional Skills:       Experience working in an agile environment, with multiple releases per year    Knowledge of CI/CD concepts and tools    Familiarity with cloud-native architecture, development, and deployment practices (e.g., AWS, Spinnaker, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform)             Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. description_html: AI & ML Software Engineer          This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.                    Who We Are:                               Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.                     Job Description:         Build the next generation of AI-powered software for the world's largest supercomputers and AI infrastructure.     From scientific discovery to next-generation AI, the world's most advanced computing systems power breakthroughs that shape the future. Join a team building observability, analytics, and AI-driven operations software that helps keep these systems resilient, performant, and running at scale.    What You'll Do    Design and build AI/ML capabilities for anomaly detection, root cause analysis, forecasting, automation, and operational intelligence.    Develop production-quality software and services using  Go, Python, React, and related technologies .    Build and integrate AI solutions including machine learning models, LLM-powered workflows, agentic systems, and advanced analytics.    Work across the full lifecycle of solution development, including data engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.    Collaborate with software engineers, architects, product managers, and customers to solve complex operational challenges at scale.    Drive technical innovation and help shape the next generation of AI-powered operations for large-scale computing environments.      What We're Looking For    Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems.    Familiarity with technologies such as  Go, Python, and React , or the ability to quickly become productive in similar technologies.    Experience building  large-scale distributed systems , observability platforms, infrastructure software, or operational tooling.    Experience applying AI/ML, GenAI, LLMs, analytics, or intelligent automation to real-world products.    Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to take ownership of complex technical challenges.    Excellent communication and collaboration skills.      Nice to Have    High Performance Computing (HPC), supercomputing, or AI infrastructure experience.    Experience with observability, telemetry, monitoring, performance analysis, or operational analytics.
